headline.zh: 为创业公司准备商业合同

scenario.zh: 你的SaaS公司需要一份标准服务协议,传统律所报价需要2周和€3000,试试Falcon的固定费用同日交付
scenario.en: Your SaaS needs a standard service agreement. Traditional firms quote 2 weeks and €3000. Try Falcon's flat-fee same-day delivery

instruction.zh: 根据你的需求选择法律服务范围
instruction.en: Select legal service scope based on your needs

label.zh: 单次合同审查(固定费用€299)

output.zh: 已创建单次项目:合同将在今日交付,由合格律师最终审核并签字
output.en: Single project created: contract delivered today with qualified lawyer final review and sign-off

output.zh: 已激活订阅计划:可提交多份文件,优先处理队列,包含所有商业法律类别
output.en: Subscription activated: submit multiple documents, priority queue, all commercial legal categories included

instruction.zh: AI需要了解业务细节以生成初稿
instruction.en: AI needs business details to generate first draft

label.zh: 上传现有模板进行调整

output.zh: AI已分析模板结构,识别15个需要本地化的条款,标记3处潜在风险点
output.en: AI analyzed template structure, identified 15 clauses needing localization, flagged 3 risk areas

output.zh: AI已根据简报生成符合GDPR的荷兰法服务协议草稿,包含标准SaaS条款库
output.en: AI generated GDPR-compliant Dutch law service agreement draft from brief, includes standard SaaS clause library

instruction.zh: AI已标记需要决策的关键条款,选择你的偏好
instruction.en: AI flagged key clauses needing decisions, choose your preference

label.zh: 客户友好版本:灵活终止和退款

output.zh: 条款已更新为30天无理由取消和按比例退款,AI提示这降低流失纠纷但可能增加退订率
output.en: Clauses updated to 30-day no-reason cancellation and prorated refunds, AI notes this reduces churn disputes but may increase cancellations

label.zh: 供应商保护版本:年度承诺和预付

output.zh: 条款已设置为12个月最低期限和季度预付,AI提示这提高收入可预测性但可能影响成交率
output.en: Clauses set to 12-month minimum term and quarterly prepayment, AI notes this improves revenue predictability but may impact close rates

instruction.zh: 合格律师已完成人工审核并签字确认
instruction.en: Qualified lawyer completed human review and signed off

output.zh: 律师确认AI草稿符合荷兰合同法,调整了2处责任上限表述,添加标准争议解决条款
output.en: Lawyer confirmed AI draft complies with Dutch contract law, refined 2 liability cap phrasings, added standard dispute resolution clause

output.zh: 已准备带律师签名的最终合同PDF,可立即发送给客户签署,总用时4小时而非2周
output.en: Final contract PDF with lawyer signature ready, can send to customer for signing immediately, total time 4 hours vs 2 weeks

takeaway.zh: Falcon用AI起草和律师签字结合,以固定费用在同日交付商业合同,已服务Loop Earplugs等付费客户
takeaway.en: Falcon combines AI drafting with lawyer sign-off to deliver commercial contracts same-day at flat fees, serving paying customers like Loop Earplugs

initial.zh: B2B SaaS服务协议:月度订阅、数据保护条款、30天终止权、荷兰法律适用
initial.en: B2B SaaS service agreement: monthly subscription, data protection clauses, 30-day termination, Dutch law
